Sara (PM): Quick pre-ship check  I'm assembling a tight GA operability checklist (SLA, latency guidance, monitoring & runbooks, support routing, pricing floor). Need owners and any absolute no-ships before I lock for shiproom.

Will (Engine): I can own perf targets and the autoscale smoke harness. Scope: p95 <=200ms for <=32-token requests on standard model families. I'll push the smoke PR early next week.

Pri (SRE): I'll take monitoring, canaries and runbooks. Must-haves: synthetic correctness canary, p99 tail/queue alerts, and a tested degraded-model fallback (route to quantized variant). Also require a CI-played regional failover drill. Those are GA-blocking until validated.

Tess (FinOps): I'll publish the GA pricing floor (hosted per-token, embeddings, reserved commit examples) and include two sample commit scenarios for sales. Enterprise discounts can be marked "pending" at GA. I need 5 biz days.

ops-bot: Created tasks OPS-7821 (autoscale-smoke) -> Will; OPS-7822 (regional-failover-drill) -> Pri.

Sara (PM): Proposed minimal acceptance (reply :thumbsup: to accept or call out blockers):

- SLA: Dedicated 99.9% monthly uptime; Hosted 99.5% initial (owner: Sara)
- Latency guidance: publish p50/p95 by model family; engineering target p95 <=200ms for <=32-token requests (owner: Will)
- Monitoring: synthetic canaries (latency + correctness), p99 tail and queue/backpressure alerts (owner: Pri)
- Runbooks: SEV1/SEV2 playbooks + degraded-model fallback documented and exercised (owner: Pri)
- Autoscale & Failover: autoscale smoke harness + scripted regional failover CI job (owners: Will/Pri)
- Docs: GA quickstart, migration notes for pilots, operational expectations + pricing FAQ (owner: Sara)
- Support: business-hours triage + SEV1 on-call escalation path documented (owner: Sara)
- Pricing: published GA floor + example commit scenarios; enterprise tiers pending (owner: Tess)

Pri (SRE): Blocking: fallback-under-load test and regional-failover CI job must be green before I sign the runbooks.

Will (Engine): Noted. I'll prioritize the autoscale burst test and KV cold-start regression.

Tess (FinOps): Draft floor by Fri; will include commit examples for sales.

Sara (PM): If no hard blockers by EOD I'll lock this as the GA operability gate for shiproom. Must-not-ship items we've agreed on: untested fallback under load, missing p99/backpressure alerts, and absent published pricing floor.

Will (Engine): :thumbsup: pending autoscale PR.

Pri (SRE): :thumbsup: pending failover + fallback tests.

Tess (FinOps): :thumbsup: (draft incoming).
